fusions.name: Taut Strand
fusions.desc: Draws a strand across the target for 9 damage, using up one of your afflictions on it.

fusions.name: Matted Web
fusions.desc: Throws a mass of strands that deals 11 damage to everything in the cone and stuns it for 0.8 seconds. Each hit leaves the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spun Bulwark
fusions.desc: Spins a web barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. For 12 seconds, a strand escort strikes beside you for 3 every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Loose Ends
fusions.desc: When a condition on you ends, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 3 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
